**Finding: compliant** (no redline).

- **§ 12.3** affirmatively disclaims any most-favoured-customer commitment by us and preserves our freedom to engage other suppliers.
- No MFN, "no less favourable", best-pricing, or third-party-matching language appears anywhere in the document.
- **§ 7.1** and **§ 8.3** are customer-favourable (fixed Fees, no undisclosed charges, capped renewal uplift) and create no hidden MFN obligation.

This sits at the preferred position (no MFN burdening the Customer), so nothing to flag.
